trigger: Full eligible-tensor WDC matched only 7/16 ordered control token streams and is rejected.
purpose: Find the largest Q4_K WDC tensor-role subset that remains 16/16 exact against the frozen ordered TP2 control oracle, then measure whether that exact subset retains a material speed gain.
fixed_configuration: Qwen3.8-27B Q4_K_M, TP2 tensor 1,1, MTP0, tuned profile, c16, context 8192, batch 2048, ubatch 256, queue settle 750 ms, launch stagger 40 ms, cache off, temperature 0, seed 42.
required_gate_per_arm: 16/16 complete token streams exactly equal the frozen oracle, zero cached tokens, complete token-ID identity, zero cross-request collisions, WDC engagement present, clean kernel log and shutdown.
advance_rule: Only exact arms advance to raw same-shape performance measurement. If multiple roles pass, test their union before promotion.
publication_policy: No role is promoted from correctness alone; it also needs repeatable raw throughput improvement and the diverse realistic-prompt exact-output suite.
